_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Reading the market's trades and holders…

description: Use this when the user asks who is buying or selling a Polymarket market, why its odds moved, or where the money is going, for example "who is buying Yes on the Fed October decision", "why did JD Vance's 2028 odds move today", "net buying on Bitcoin $150K this week", or "who holds the most of this market". Takes one market (a slug, a supported market or event link, a condition id, or plain words; for a multi-outcome event it uses the leading open outcome, or a ladder's most-traded open rung, and says so) and a window of 1 to 168 hours (default 24). Returns PredictionScan's flow breakdown from Polymarket.com's public trades: dollars bought and sold and the net per outcome, the trade count, up to 8 largest trades, and up to 5 top holders per outcome with their share counts. Dollar totals count each fill once (its taker side), so they run about half of the two-sided volume Polymarket.com headlines. In very busy markets small fills may be left out so the whole window fits; the text says so. Read-only: flow describes past trades, not where the price will go.

hours.description: How far back to look, in hours (default 24, max 168 = 7 days)

market.description: The market: a slug, a supported market or event link, a condition id, or a few words like 'fed october no change'

name: get_market_flow

size_usd.description: US dollars that changed hands (shares x price; a wallet's own fills include the taker fee)

share_of_top_pct.description: This holder's share of the listed top holders' shares on that outcome

title: Get market flow
